text: If you want to get braces, I highly recommend coming here. The doctor, Dr. Siriporn, is very kind and gentle. 😊 …
The staff provided excellent service, offering great advice and consultations. The doctor was lovely, skilled, thorough, and gave truly excellent advice. I'll definitely be a regular customer here!
I had braces here before. The dentist placed the braces very low. After the braces were put on, the teeth moved, but the roots didn't move. They ended up crooked!

The service was excellent, from the counter staff who called to check in via chat – they were all very polite and friendly. The dentist gave great advice and did a fantastic job. The clinic was clean and parking was convenient.

text:
The doctor is very nice, but this branch has only one issue: the counter staff are terrible, some of them specifically. In our case, we frequently encountered a staff member with glasses, of average build, who made mistakes in scheduling. She kept apologizing, but it wasted our time. I wonder how the clinic owner will address this behavior. I want to know if she even cares about the clients' cases when she's working, because every trip to the clinic costs money and time, and this hasn't happened once before; it's happened many times. She seems to be just going through the motions. The only counter staff who seems to work well is a slightly overweight, dark-skinned woman who is very nice and always gives us accurate appointment times. But I guess I'm just unlucky to encounter her so often; she always makes mistakes. Moving cases incurs costs and wastes time starting over. The clinic owner should look into this. We are paying for your services, so shouldn't we receive good service? From a regular customer who brings her mother and sister to get dental work done here because the doctor is kind and lovely.
But now, I just want to finish my own appointment and I don't want to set foot in this clinic again. No matter how good the clinic is, if the service is terrible, nobody wants to come here.

I had my wisdom tooth removed here, and the dentist was amazing!
She suggests clearly, very skilled, and was almost painless.
The treatment cost was also very reasonable.

The atmosphere at the clinic is nice, but they should be more punctual. I waited for an hour. If you have other errands to run, I recommend informing the staff. Also, the prices should be clearly stated before any procedure. Have the doctor tell you the price before starting to avoid mistakes like mine.
The teeth are very clean. I highly recommend it. 😍 …

I always have my dental appointments with Dr. Anuphan on Mondays. He's very patient, kind, gentle, and gives honest advice. The staff are also very helpful and never rude. They respond to messages quickly. The waiting area is comfortable, air-conditioned, and they provide water.

I came for teeth whitening, and the price was amazing! It was a paired package, but I got it for just one person – fantastic! This is my second time already. I don't want a third time though, because it's a bit sensitive, haha. But I'm hooked because it really does make my smile look prettier. You have to endure some pain to be beautiful, everyone!

The advantages are that you can use social security insurance and get a medical certificate to claim reimbursement. The disadvantages are that I wasn't very impressed with the doctor; the procedure was painful and their words didn't make me want to come back for a repeat treatment.
The doctor and assistant were very helpful and attentive. The price was reasonable. There's parking across the street.
I went to get my teeth scaled and whitened. The dentist and staff provided excellent service. The price was reasonable. I was able to use my social security benefits.
